generation.algorithm: Campaign 2 paintRoad deterministic bounded lateral walk

notes: Each cells array contains the exact ordered primary and lateral hexes painted by paintRoad, with consecutive cells adjacent.
Waypoints are captured after the optional lateral step in each iteration, matching the source onStep callback timing.
This is the five main crossroads roads only. It does not include local spurs, manually connected Kragmoor/Sil'thandriel roads, or later connectAllRoadNetworks repairs.
Validate against a fresh original Campaign 2 browser bootstrap before treating the manifest as a golden master.
